Allopurinol is a tautomeric mixture of 1H-pyra- zolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-ol and 1,5-dihydro-4H-pyrazolo[3,4- d]pyrimidin-4-one. Pharmacopoeias. In Chin., Eur. (see p.vii), Int., Jpn, and US. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Allopurinol). A white or almost white powder. Very slightly soluble in water and in alcohol; dissolves in dilute solutions of alkali hydroxides. USP 31 (Allopurinol). A fluffy white to off-white powder having only a slight odour. Very slightly soluble in water and in alcohol; practically insoluble in chloroform and in ether; soluble in solu- tions of potassium and sodium hydroxides. Incompatibility.
